_meta.description: Tracks 2026 report coverage progress per company, plus an inferred/searched calendar of each company's next expected filing. Read and updated by the standing '2026 report coverage' loop — see CLAUDE.md 'Standing priority' section for how this drives what to work on next. Keyed by ticker (uppercase, matching scripts/data/sp500.json / scripts/data/us-listed.json).
_meta.schemaNote: status: 'done' once a qualifying 2026 report (ANNUAL if FY2026 is out, else latest reported 2026 quarter) is published — this is the tier-1 finish line, see CLAUDE.md 'Standing priority'. nextExpectedFiling is an estimate for Phase 2 (freshness maintenance, once tier 1 is fully done/skipped) — not a blocker during tier-1 backlog processing. 'reports' (added 2026-09-13, backfilled retroactively where known) lists every period already published for that company, across all fiscal years — originally scoped to fiscal-2026 only, now also the record for tier-2 multi-year backfill (2026-09-15+: once a company is 'done', additional entries for other years get appended here as tier 2 adds them). 'allAvailable2026QuartersCovered: true' means no further *2026* backfill is owed as of lastChecked — it says nothing about other years' coverage.

GRDX.name: GridAI Technologies Corp.

nextExpectedFiling.basis: quarter ends 2026-09-30; ~45-day filing deadline typical for a smaller reporting company

GRDX.note: 10-Q/A filed 2026-09-18 was a non-financial amendment (SEC-comment-driven goodwill disclosure rewrite in Notes 3/7 + expanded Critical Accounting Policies) — no figures changed vs. the original 10-Q (accession 0001104659-26-099751, filed 2026-08-21); verified by diffing both. MGLD.name: The Marygold Companies, Inc.

nextExpectedFiling.basis: fiscal year ends 2026-06-30; first fiscal-2027 quarterly 10-Q typically ~45 days after quarter end (~2026-09-30)

MGLD.note: Fiscal year ends June 30, so FY2026 = July 2025-June 2026. Revenue from continuing ops +8% to $25.3M, net loss narrowed 25% to $4.4M, but both figures are distorted: USCF Investments average AUM +41% to $4.1B, masked by a $2.5M USO oil-futures trading-error reimbursement booked as a revenue reduction (ex that, fund-mgmt revenue +38% not +23%) and by the July 2025 Brigadier segment sale (to related party/director Scott Schoenberger) leaving the base. $3.6M of impairments (UK financial-services goodwill/intangibles + private-bank stake) also hit the year; goodwill/intangibles now at zero. NZ Food Products (profitable) reclassified to discontinued ops 2026-03-31 pending sale. $19.5M cumulative fintech investment since 2019 vs $19.2M total equity; both US/UK apps paused.

NEUP.name: Neuphoria Therapeutics Inc.

nextExpectedFiling.basis: fiscal year ends 2026-06-30; ~45-day smaller-reporting-company deadline

NEUP.note: Clinical-stage biotech (fiscal year ends June 30). Phase 3 AFFIRM-1 (BNC210, social anxiety) missed its primary endpoint 2025-10-20; company terminated leases and nearly all staff (now 1 FTE), PTSD program on hold. Revenue -92.5% to $1.17M (FY2025 had a one-off $15.0M Merck milestone); net loss widened to $13.45M, mostly a $5.36M non-cash goodwill impairment after Merck ended the MK-1167 Alzheimer's Phase 2 for futility, plus $1.28M restructuring — underlying R&D+G&A spend actually fell 34.5%. Cash rose to $19.87M via ATM share sales (+173.5% share count). Agreed 2026-07-23 to be acquired by Scancell Holdings plc at ~$4.55/share (~$24.6M), below the ATM average price and below Lynx1's earlier withdrawn indications; holders get ~11.1% of combined co. + 1 CVR. Merger targeted to close late 2026 — NEUP may stop filing standalone, worth checking before assuming another quarterly is coming.

NTNX.name: Nutanix, Inc. - Class A

nextExpectedFiling.basis: fiscal year ends 2026-07-31, quarters end Oct/Jan/Apr/Jul 31; ~40-day post-quarter filing cadence observed historically

NTNX.note: Fiscal year ends July 31. Revenue +12% to $2,853.5M, non-GAAP operating margin +260bps to 23.7%. GAAP net income's 8x jump to $1,506.8M ($5.17 diluted EPS) is almost entirely a $1,208.2M non-cash release of the US deferred-tax valuation allowance — pre-tax income only rose $211.6M->$327.1M; GAAP EPS ($5.17) now exceeds non-GAAP EPS ($2.04), flagged as backwards vs the usual direction. FY2027 guidance ($3.180-3.230B revenue, 24-25% non-GAAP op margin, $850-950M FCF) implies no growth acceleration. Aug 2026 5% headcount cut booked $27.6M severance with zero cash paid, flattering FY2026's $840.7M FCF. ARR +16%, RPO +28%, both ahead of revenue growth. Repurchased 9.4M shares at avg $51.24 while separately selling 4.14M shares to AMD at $36.26 (May 2026 private placement). Stockholders' equity flipped from -$694.5M to +$702.6M.
